gen.title: Scope, exemptions and service under the proclamation

cards.stem: Where did the proclamation apply according to its limits?
options: states that had seceded from the Union
loyal free states in New England
all western territories
northern industrial cities
cards.quote: It applied only to states that had seceded from the Union, leaving slavery untouched in the loyal border states.
cards.hint: Think which states were considered in rebellion.

cards.stem: Which additional areas were expressly exempted from freedom under the order?
options: parts of the Confederacy that had already come under Union control
areas still actively in rebellion
border states that had seceded
regions beyond United States territory
cards.quote: It also expressly exempted parts of the Confederacy that had already come under Union control.
cards.hint: Consider areas already under federal control.

cards.stem: What was the North's initial reason for fighting the Civil War?
options: prevent the secession of the Southern states and preserve the Union
abolish slavery throughout the nation immediately
establish trade agreements with Europe
expand federal control over western lands
cards.quote: prevent the secession of the Southern states and preserve the Union
cards.hint: Remember the early goal before emancipation.
